newsitem.title: USA: First California denies wrongdoing, to fight SEC.
newsitem.headline: First California denies wrongdoing, to fight SEC.

text.p: Underwriter First California Capital Markets Group Inc on Monday denied any wrongdoing and vowed to fight a lawsuit filed by the Securities and Exchange Commission, its attorney said.
The SEC sued First California for allegedly defrauding investors who bought $69 million of bonds in five California municipal offerings.

The lawsuit alleged that First California principal H. Michael Richardson and former manager Derrick Dumont lied to investors and omitted important information from bond offering documents about the risks investors faced.
"First California, Mike Richardson and Derrick Dumont deny unequivocally the claims and charges made by the SEC," their attorney, Charles Klinedinst, said.

"It is ironic that after three years of investigation involving literally dozens of witnesses, the SEC's charges come down to five bond issues that are all currently paying," Klinedinst said. "They've got nothing."
